title: Appointment Availability
description:
Hi Esther!

I'm reaching out regarding your name on our waiting list for appointment
availability. Dr. Rubin is not accepting patients at this time, but I would
be more than happy to schedule you with Dr. Christine Vaccaro. She has a
last-minute cancellation available this Friday at either 10 or 10:30am.
Since I am working through the waitlist, I cannot hold this appointment. If
this date does not work for you, please let me know and I can schedule you
for a later date!

To get you started, Please follow the instructions below for registration
and the portal, access. As a reminder: *1) Register on portal 2) Complete
the Practice Policies form 3) Upload credit card information for now and
future visits.*

*Important insurance and pricing info (please read): *

   - We *do not accept* insurance for our appointments.
   - We *do not participate* in Medicare or Medicaid.
   - After your visit, we're happy to provide a superbill for you to submit
   to your insurance company if you have out-of-network benefits.
   - *New patient appointments are 90 mins and cost $1,500* and there
is a *$250
   non-refundable administrative fee/deposit* to reserve your spot and will
   go towards your appointment cost.

*Next steps:*

As part of on-boarding, we'll have you set up a patient portal account
<https://rachelrubinmd.md-hq.com/registration> which helps us securely
